from slug import slugify


def test_slugify_collapses_space_runs():
    assert slugify('a  b') == 'a-b'


def test_slugify_lowercases():
    assert slugify('Hello') == 'hello'


def test_slugify_collapses_mixed_whitespace_runs():
    assert slugify('a \t\nb') == 'a-b'


def test_slugify_single_tab_becomes_hyphen():
    assert slugify('a\tb') == 'a-b'


def test_slugify_single_space_becomes_hyphen():
    assert slugify('a b') == 'a-b'


def test_slugify_lowercases_across_words():
    assert slugify('Hello  WORLD') == 'hello-world'
E

cat > slug.py <<'E'
import re


def slugify(title: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r'\s+', '-', title.lower())
